CreateCaveManager(nint, int)

Allocates an executable memory page in the target process near a preferred address, managed by a CaveManager instance to allow the creation of multiple smaller caves and hooks in a single memory allocation with ease.

public CaveManager CreateCaveManager(nint address, int size = 4096)

Parameters

address nint

The preferred baseline address to start searching from.

size int

The total size of the parent page to allocate. Defaults to 4096 bytes which is the size of a single page.

Returns

CaveManager

A managed CaveManager instance capable of spawning safe sub-allocations.

Exceptions

InvalidOperationException

Thrown if Windows fails to allocate memory after searching.

CreateDetour(nint, int)

Allocates memory for and creates a Detour. Use Write(nint, int, ReadOnlySpan<byte>) to write custom instructions. The Detour automatically writes JMP instructions to and from the Detour after writing your instructions.

public Detour CreateDetour(nint address, int size = 4096)

Parameters

address nint

The preferred baseline address to start searching for free memory from.

size int

The total size of the parent page to allocate. Defaults to 4096 bytes which is the size of a single page.

Returns

Detour

A managed CodeCave instance capable of spawning safe sub-allocations.

Exceptions

InvalidOperationException

Thrown if Windows fails to allocate memory after searching.

CreateDetour(nint, int, ReadOnlySpan<byte>, int)

Allocates memory for and creates a Detour. Automatically writes your custom payload to the detour using Write(nint, int, ReadOnlySpan<byte>) The Detour automatically writes JMP instructions to and from the Detour after writing your instructions.

public Detour CreateDetour(nint address, int bytesReplaced, ReadOnlySpan<byte> payload, int size = 4096)

Parameters

address nint

The preferred baseline address to start searching for free memory from.

bytesReplaced int

Number of bytes that will be replaced when writing the the JMP from the original game code to the detour.

payload ReadOnlySpan<byte>

A ReadOnlySpan<T> containing custom bytes to automatically write in the Detour

size int

The total size of the parent page to allocate. Defaults to 4096 bytes which is the size of a single page.

Returns

Detour

A managed CodeCave instance capable of spawning safe sub-allocations.

Exceptions

InvalidOperationException

Thrown if Windows fails to allocate memory after searching.

ScanMemory(ReadOnlySpan<char>, nint)

Scans for an array of bytes, returning a list of results. To avoid bad results, try to make the array of bytes as unique as possible.

public nint ScanMemory(ReadOnlySpan<char> signature, nint startAddress = 0)

Parameters

signature ReadOnlySpan<char>

Bytes to scan for for passed in a string. ?? and ? are treated as wildcards. Example: "48 8B ?? ?? 48"

startAddress nint

Base address of memory module to start scan from.

Returns

nint

List contining address found matching provided byte signature. If the scan was good, it is usually the first address.

ScanMemory(ReadOnlySpan<byte?>, nint)

Scans for an array of bytes, returning a list of results. To avoid bad results, try to make the array of bytes as unique as possible.

public nint ScanMemory(ReadOnlySpan<byte?> signature, nint startAddress = 0)

Parameters

signature ReadOnlySpan<byte?>

Bytes to scan for for passed in a ReadOnlySpan<T>. Null bytes are treated as wildcards. Example: [0x48, 0x8B, null, null, 0x48]

startAddress nint

Base address of memory module to start scan from.

Returns

nint

List contining address found matching provided byte signature. If the scan was good, it is usually the first address.
